{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''More'' than my fee. This droid is worth more, I get ''paid'' more. Now I suggest—|Gha Nachkt's last words before being stabbed by Grievous.|audio=MoreThanMyFee-DotD.flac|<ref name="DotD" />}}
'''Gha Nachkt''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] who owned the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenged]] the remains and leftover debris from battles for items he could sell to either of the two fighting factions, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Although Nachkt was not allied with either organization in the war, he dealt with the Confederacy on numerous occasions, working with [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]—the legislative branch of the Confederacy. Anticipating that an adversary of his, the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], was planning on buying a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from Nachkt, Tambor hired the Trandoshan to instead sell Argente a spy droid planted by Tambor. After the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], he found [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] belonging to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and resolved to sell the droid to the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

When Argente arrived on the ''Vulture's Claw'' to buy a droid to spy on Tambor, Nachkt sold Tambor's planted droid to Argente, receiving [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from both parties. When Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], saw the ''Vulture's Claw'' on the battlefield, they came on board to search for R2-D2. The scavenger hid the droid from them and claimed that he had not found any astromech droids in the wake of the battle. After Skywalker and Tano left, Nachkt traveled to the Separatist [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] to give the droid to Grievous. When the Trandoshan arrived at the station, he was instructed by Grievous to take the droid apart and extract whatever information the droid carried. Nachkt, however, found that R2-D2 contained more important information than he had originally thought, and demanded more payment from Grievous. In retribution, Grievous [[Shiak|stabbed]] Nachkt with his lightsaber, instantly [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Trandoshan.

==Biography==
===Scavenger===
{{Quote|Magistrate, you think me a hatchling. You have a droid army! You're allied to the Techno Union! You have plenty of droids.|Gha Nachkt, to Magistrate Passel Argente|<ref name="Discount">''[[The Clone Wars: Discount]]''</ref>}}
[[File:TamborGhaNachkt.png|thumb|left|220px|Gha Nachkt speaks with Wat Tambor, shortly after Argente's purchase of the spy droid.]]
Gha Nachkt was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]<ref name="Complete Season One" /> and a level five [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmer<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Decoded">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid|d=y}}</ref> who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], scavenging the debris left over after battles for items he could sell. Nachkt was not allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] or [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the war, and was more concerned about how many [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he could gain. Due to this, he sold his salvage to the highest bidder. In his [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]], the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], Nachkt searched the debris left over from battles for any merchandise he could sell. He had a number of droids, including several [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]], aboard his [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], scavenged from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="TCW:TVG" /> His right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was injured in a fight that he started in a Coruscant [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], causing his face to become permanently asymmetrical.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Decoded" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Nachkt visited the restaurant [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While he was there, he overheard an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] talking about a recent attack on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and later spotted a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], who had came to the diner to speak to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the restaurant's owner. Nachkt offered to help the Padawan in return for some credits, and the Padawan accepted, then asked Nachkt if he knew anything about the attack on the Senate. The Trandoshan advised the Padawan to go and speak to [[Koro Ferbin]], an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who resided in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a Coruscant [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] institution.<ref name="Crisis on Coruscant">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Crisis on Coruscant]]''</ref>

During the war, Nachkt provided transport for the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she met with the Separatist [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] and proceeded to the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] with him. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] later found Nachkt while searching for information on Ventress, and after learning about Nachkt's actions, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] proceeded to Cato Neimoidia to question Tuuk. When Tuuk hired Nachkt to smuggle [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]] from their [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] herds to Tatooine as part of a smuggling ring under the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], Nachkt was intercepted at a [[Rodia/Legends|Rodian]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] by the same Jedi Knight. After disabling the ''Vulture's Claw'' and boarding it to retrieve the stolen shaaks, the same Jedi Knight whom Nachkt had just dealt with confronted the Trandoshan smuggler, who revealed that he had been hired by Tuuk. While investigating thefts of several Republic military vehicles, the Jedi Knight again encountered Nachkt on Tatooine and questioned him about the thefts. Not willing to cooperate with the Jedi's questioning, Nachkt escaped aboard the ''Vulture's Claw'', though the ship crashed in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of Tatooine. There, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang of pirates]] [[Skirmish on the Dune Sea|attacked]] Nachkt and the Jedi, though Nachkt was able to escape during the [[Lightfight|firefight]].<ref name="CWA: Card Commander">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref>

At some point afterward, the scavenger was approached by [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], who offered to pay him to sell a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] droid to [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], an adversary of Tambor's. Argente would have no idea of the droid's true programming, and so the droid would be able to spy on Argente and report back on his dealings to the Foreman. The Trandoshan agreed to the offer, and Tambor gave him the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was to be sold to Argente.<ref name="Discount" />

===Salvaging an astromech droid===
{{Quote|You sneaky little scrap pile. You'd better be worth all this trouble.|Gha Nachkt, to R2-D2|audio=SneakyLittleScrapPile-DotD.flac|<ref name="DotD" />}}
During the Republic's [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|defense]] of the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] lost his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The astromech contained information on Republic battle plans, formations, and bases that would be an asset to the Confederacy. Nachkt, on a search for debris he could sell after the battle, discovered R2-D2 and brought the droid aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''. Inside, Nachkt discovered the information the astromech droid contained, and decided to sell it to the Confederate [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="DotD" />

[[File:GhaNachkt-Discount.png|thumb|right|250px|Nachkt in his ship, the ''Vulture's Claw'']]
Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Ambush on the Vulture's Claw/Legends|searched]] the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] for the lost astromech. When the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] came aboard the ''Vulture's Claw'', Nachkt hid Skywalker's droid, instead escorting the Jedi to another area of the ship. Skywalker and Tano searched the ship, but instead of finding R2-D2, they confronted two of Nachkt's sentinel droids and destroyed them. The Jedi left the ship, believing that the droid was not on board, and Nachkt was displeased with the damages the Jedi had caused. Nachkt contacted General Grievous and agreed to transfer R2-D2<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="TCW:TVG" /><ref name="DoaD Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> at the general's Separatist [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], and collect his payment.<ref name="DotD" />

After Skywalker and Tano had departed from the ship, Magistrate Argente arrived aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''. Argente bribed Nachkt with credits to keep the details of their meeting private. Nachkt agreed, and Argente claimed that he wanted a droid to spy on Wat Tambor, believing that the Foreman was up to something. Initially, Argente wanted to buy R2-D2, but the scavenger told him that the Republic astromech droid was not for sale. Nachkt instead persuaded him into buying the special [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] that the Foreman had given him, and Argente bought the droid and left. After the Koorivar's departure, the Trandoshan contacted Tambor, informing him of the mission's completion, and the Foreman then transmitted the credits to Nachkt's account.<ref name="Discount" />

===Skytop Station===
{{Quote|There's your bonus.|General Grievous, shortly after stabbing Gha Nachkt in the back|audio=TheresYourBonus-DuelOfTheDroids.flac|<ref name="DotD" />}}
[[File:GhaNachktDeath.png|thumb|left|230px|Nachkt is killed by General Grievous.]]
''En route'' to Skytop Station, R2-D2 attempted to escape from the ''Vulture's Claw''. Removing the [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] keeping him confined, R2-D2 also managed to jettison an IG-86 sentinel droid that was guarding him into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The scavenger, however, awoke from sleep in time to recapture the R2 unit and put him back into confinement. The astromech droid managed to contact Skywalker and transmit his location before Nachkt discovered the droid's actions and debilitated the R2 unit with an [[ion prod]].<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="DotD Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode007.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duel of the Droids}}</ref>

After arriving at Grievous's rendezvous point, the general instructed Nachkt to take R2-D2 apart and extract the information from him, allowing the Confederacy to gain information about the Republic and its strategies. To stop the Confederacy from gaining the information in R2-D2's databanks, Skywalker and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] launched a [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to rescue R2-D2.<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="DotD Ep Guide" />

Nachkt, having taken R2-D2 apart, discovered the extensive Republic information inside the droid. Deciding that the data was worth more than he had initially thought, Nachkt demanded more credits from Grievous, as the general himself also believed that the droid was worth more to him. After requesting a larger fee for his work, however, Grievous, having tired of the Trandoshan continually asking for more money, drew one of his stolen green-bladed lightsabers. Gha Nachkt was [[Shiak|impaled]] from behind by Grievous's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and the scavenger's life was [[Death/Legends|ended]].<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="DotD Ep Guide" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This I always understand.|Gha Nachkt, on credits|<ref name="Discount" />}}
[[File:GhaNachktNegotiates-DotD.png|thumb|right|230px|Nachkt haggles with General Grievous.]]
Although his ugly features hid his keen mind,<ref name="TCWCE" /> Nachkt lacked morals, refraining from solidly siding himself with either the Republic or the Confederacy in order to gain more credits for whatever he found. The Trandoshan would search the debris left over from any battle to scavenge pieces he could sell to either the Republic or Confederacy.<ref name="DoaD Ep Guide" /> Nachkt lied and hid items of interest if he felt being honest would mean he would lose any merchandise he would otherwise be able to sell. As such, he hid R2-D2 from Tano and Skywalker when they searched for the droid aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''.<ref name="DotD" /> The Trandoshan was also greedy, reflected by his demands to General Grievous to raise his payment for R2-D2 above what they had originally agreed.<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="DotD Ep Guide" /> This was also shown by his eagerness to accept a bribe from Argente.<ref name="Discount" /> However, his greediness was ultimately his downfall, as the Trandoshan was killed when he requested a higher amount of payment from Grievous.<ref name="DotD" />

Nachkt had a distinct lack of personal hygiene. Aboard the ''Vulture's Claw'', he did not withhold flatulence, as was noticed by Ahsoka Tano upon visiting the ''Vulture's Claw'' while searching for R2-D2.<ref name="DotD" /> His fingernails were often in need of a clipping, and his smelly feet even became legendary to others.<ref name="TCWCE" /> The scavenger's right eye was injured in a cantina fight that he started on Coruscant, leaving a lasting asymmetry to his face.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Decoded" /> He was talented in starship piloting and droid programming.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I wanted a Trandoshan because I like Bossk, but my friend Giancarlo pointed out that you can't make every character in the prime of their life. So I made this arms dealer a really fat, bloated lizard instead.|Supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] discusses the concept of Nachkt's character|<ref name="The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
Gha Nachkt first appeared in "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," an episode in the [[2008]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="DotD Ep Guide" /> Nachkt also appeared in the following episode, "[[Duel of the Droids]]," and was featured in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Discount|''Discount'']], which led into "Duel of the Droids." In both television episodes, Nachkt was voiced by [[Ron Perlman]].<ref name="DoaD Ep Guide" /><ref name="DotD Ep Guide" /> Nachkt later received an entry in the [[July]] [[2009]] ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. Nachkt's asymmetrical face design was used to further promote his corruption and untrustworthy elements.<ref name="Complete Season One" /> His character design was later used as the basis for [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], another Trandoshan appearing in the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Lightsaber Lost]]."<ref name="Lightsaber Lost Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> A Trandoshan with an identical model and texture to Gha Nachkt is seen in Ziro's palace in the movie, stirring some debate, but this has not been officially confirmed as him.

Nachkt appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny|''Decide Your Destiny'']] book [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Crisis on Coruscant|''Crisis on Coruscant'']], where it is possible for the reader, who is role-playing as a Jedi Padawan, to encounter Nachkt in Dex's Diner. The reader then has the choice whether or not to accept Nachkt's offer to help them.<ref name="Crisis on Coruscant" />
